title: The Hound-Bell of Camlorn
summary: Stop a werewolf pack and briar-heart cultists from shattering the ancient Wyrd-stones that keep the moor-dead of Cath Bedraud and Camlorn asleep.

npcs.name: Canon Alain of Camlorn
npcs.greet: Bar your shutters when the moor-fog rolls in, traveller! The bronze Hound-Bell of Camlorn rang three times last night with no hand on the rope.
talk: Whenever the Hound-Bell tolls of its own accord, the skin-changers of the northern moors are hunting near the barrows.
Worse still, overzealous cathedral wardens pulled down the Beldama Wyrd's root-charms at Crosswych, and now the cairn-dead are stirring. Speak with Wyrd-Sister Morwen in Eagles Brook.

npcs.name: Wyrd-Sister Morwen
npcs.greet: The town-priests call our root-knots pagan superstition—until the bog-water turns red and the wolves walk on two legs.
talk: Pack-Leader Vargau has allied with grave-diggers in Enduum to uproot the three Anchor-Stones of Wynbrook.
Meet Commander Sebastien at Lion Guard Redoubt; his rangers saw Vargau's pack dragging iron cages toward Ravenford Hollow.

npcs.name: Commander Sebastien
npcs.greet: Silver-tipped bolts are worth their weight in gold today, friend. My sentries took three werewolf rushes before dawn.
talk: The pack's huntsman, Garnier the Red-Pelt, has kenneled his beasts inside Ravenford Hollow to ambush pilgrims on the Crosswych road.
Slay Garnier in Ravenford Hollow, then join Wyrd-Sister Morwen at Enduum where Vargau is digging up the king-cairns.

npcs.name: Ward-Keeper Loic
npcs.greet: Hold the Torch of Arkay high! The barrow-mists from Enduum are creeping right up to the walls of Cryptwatch Fort.
talk: Alpha Vargau is inside Enduum right now, soaking the Wyrd-root in werewolf blood to wake the barrow-kings.
Go in and sever his head before the last seal cracks!

story_gl_wynbrook_cairn: Wyrd-Sister Morwen: Look at the Wynbrook menhir—claw-gouges across the elven spiral, and cathedral lime splashed over the root-knot.
Canon Alain of Camlorn: My wardens were fools to deface the Wyrd-stones. Without the green-ward, the dead beneath the peat hear the wolves howling.
Wyrd-Sister Morwen: Go to Lion Guard Redoubt and Ravenford Hollow; we must draw the pack's fangs before moonrise.
story_gl_ravenford_kennel: Garnier the Red-Pelt: Smell that, brothers? Town-bread and cathedral incense! Camlorn's sheep have walked into the den!
Commander Sebastien: Loose silver bolts! Do not let them close the distance!
Garnier the Red-Pelt: Silver only makes the blood hotter!
story_gl_enduum_barrow: Alpha Vargau: When the old kings of Enduum rise from the peat, Camlorn's stone walls will crumble like dry bark!
Wyrd-Sister Morwen: The earth remembers older oaths than yours, beast! Strike him down!

quests.title: When the Hound-Bell Tolls
quests.summary: Speak with Wyrd-Sister Morwen in Eagles Brook and inspect the defaced ward-stones at Wynbrook Stones.
intro: The Hound-Bell of Camlorn has tolled a warning of werewolf packs on the moors, while a dispute between cathedral wardens and the Beldama Wyrd has weakened the barrow-wards.
Travel to Eagles Brook to consult Wyrd-Sister Morwen and inspect the menhirs at Wynbrook Stones.
complete: At Wynbrook Stones, Morwen and Canon Alain discovered that werewolf claws and broken root-wards have unsealed the ancient cairns.

journal.start: Canon Alain in Camlorn asked me to meet Wyrd-Sister Morwen in Eagles Brook and check Wynbrook Stones.
journal.done: We confirmed that werewolf packs are intentionally breaking the Wyrd-wards across the Glenumbra moors.

quests.title: The Red-Pelt's Kennel
quests.summary: Report to Commander Sebastien at Lion Guard Redoubt and slay Garnier the Red-Pelt inside Ravenford Hollow.
intro: Commander Sebastien's rangers at Lion Guard Redoubt have tracked half the werewolf pack to Ravenford Hollow.
Meet Commander Sebastien at Lion Guard Redoubt, then enter Ravenford Hollow and kill Garnier the Red-Pelt.
complete: Garnier the Red-Pelt was slain in Ravenford Hollow, revealing that Alpha Vargau has marched south to Cryptwatch Fort and Enduum.

journal.start: I must report to Commander Sebastien at Lion Guard Redoubt and clear Garnier's pack from Ravenford Hollow.
journal.done: I slew Garnier the Red-Pelt in Ravenford Hollow and learned Alpha Vargau is inside the barrows of Enduum.

quests.title: Mist Over Cryptwatch
quests.summary: Check the northern road at Crosswych and bolster Ward-Keeper Loic at Cryptwatch Fort.
intro: Barrow-mist is pouring from the southern cairns while Crosswych's miners barricade their shafts.
Pass through Crosswych to secure silver-salt torches and bring them to Ward-Keeper Loic at Cryptwatch Fort.
complete: Ward-Keeper Loic used the silver-salt to hold the outer wall of Cryptwatch Fort while you prepare to enter Enduum.

journal.start: I must collect silver-salt at Crosswych and report to Ward-Keeper Loic at Cryptwatch Fort.
journal.done: Ward-Keeper Loic secured the perimeter around Enduum.

quests.title: The Barrow-Kings of Enduum
quests.summary: Descend into Enduum, slay Alpha Vargau the Moor-Stalker, and restore the Wyrd-seal with Canon Alain in Camlorn.
intro: Deep inside Enduum, Alpha Vargau is drenching the heart-root of the Wyrd in blood to raise the ancient kings of the moor.
Enter Enduum, slay Alpha Vargau, and bring word of the restored concord back to Canon Alain in Camlorn.
complete: Alpha Vargau is dead, the Wyrd-sisters have re-woven the barrow-wards of Enduum, and Camlorn's cathedral has sworn never again to disturb the green-stones.

journal.start: I must enter Enduum, defeat Alpha Vargau, and return to Canon Alain in Camlorn.
journal.done: I defeated Alpha Vargau in Enduum and restored peace between Camlorn's clergy and the Wyrd.
